name: Unpack Week
description: You moved. Seven days from boxes to a place that feels like yours.

0.title: Beds made, shower working, coffee or tea findable
Order easy dinner — unpacking is enough work for one day

1.title: KITCHEN: unpack to working, flatten the boxes
Find the box with the chargers and the meds

3.title: CLOTHES: closet to working, not perfect
Flatten boxes, stack them by the door

4.title: Photograph anything broken in transit, for claims

5.title: DESK corner working: wifi, a clear surface
Change your address at just 3 places: bank, license, one subscription

6.title: Hang ONE thing on a wall. It's home now.
Boxes out to recycling or storage
Order the good takeout. You moved.
